answer: In the orchard every graft is cut from a tree the grafter planted himself, and the cut is sealed with wax the same day. A copper grafted onto another man's stock is spotted when the fruit ripens wrong. Asbestos surveyor licence with safety executive attestation stops the forgery at the root: one-year training, 200 supervised surveys, exam, annual renewal. The meadow is the forfeit, three seasons of fruit given to the orchard's owner, and the summit is the graft book, signed by the head gardener each spring.
